text: Dear God, I set two mugs out this morning without thinking. Then I remembered Tom won't be coming down the stairs.
Lord, the funeral was Saturday. Everyone has gone home and the house is so quiet. I don't know how to do this without Mum.
miss my grandpa
why: short; missing someone who has passed

text: Five years today since we lost Ellie. The world kept going but I always stop on this date. Hold her for me, Lord.
Dad's birthday today. First one without him. I bought a card out of habit and just sat in the car with it.
Lord, I cried in the shower again this morning. Nothing's wrong exactly, I just feel heavy.
Sad.
Ok God I just need to get this out. Work was a nightmare, the bus was late, my roommate ate my leftoversss and nobody even asked how I was. I just need someone to hear me rant for once.
I don't need advice. I just need to say it to Someone. Today hurt and I'm tired of pretending it didn't.
why: wants to be heard, not fixed

text: It's been months of this grey fog. I go to work, come home, lie on the couch. I told my doctor I think it might be depression.
Lord I havent showered in 4 days and the dishes are piled up. Every morning feels like lifting concrete. its been like this since summer.
Dear God, it's my first Christmas in Canada and I miss my mother's cooking and our little parish back in Manila. Nobody here knows the hymns I grew up with.
why: away from home country and church

text: Moved for uni three weeks ago. Everyone seems to already have their friends. I miss my home church so much.
Lord, I'm 82 and the phone hasn't rung all week. I'd just like someone to ask how I'm doing.
God, everyone at small group has someone. I go home to an empty flat and talk to the cat. I'd love one real friend.
My biopsy results come back Thursday and I can't stop running through every possibility. Help me breathe, Lord.
cant sleep. keep thinking about the presentation tmrw and everyone staring at me
Three kids, a full-time job, Mom's appointments, the church bake sale... I'm drowning and the list keeps growing.
Lord it's all too much today.
tired.
I've said yes to every rota at church and now I'm running on fumes. I love serving, but I'm empty.
I lied to my wife about where I was last night. It was small but it's eating at me. Please forgive me and help me tell her.
I was short with my mum on the phone and she sounded hurt. I should ring her back and apologise.
I am FURIOUS. My brother took the inheritance paperwork and signed it without telling any of us. Keep me from saying something I'll regret.
My manager took credit for my work in front of everyone. I'm shaking I'm so mad.
Do I take the job in Denver or stay near my parents? I've prayed and made lists and I still don't know. Give me wisdom.
Lord, we've been offered a place for Sophie at two schools and we have to choose by Friday.
Lord, You feel so far away lately. I say the words but it's like talking to a ceiling.
Honestly I'm not sure I believe any of this anymore. But I'm still writing to You, so maybe that means something.
WE'RE PREGNANT!!! Thank you thank you thank you!
Got into nursing school!! I literally screamed in the car park.
Thank you for the friends who brought dinner every night this week. I didn't have to ask once.
ty God
I've been so blessed this year. Show me where I can give some of it back, Lord, maybe the food bank?
We finally paid off the house. I'd like to sponsor a kid's school fees or something. Point me somewhere.
Someone sat with me last year when I was falling apart. I want to be that for someone else now. Show me who needs an ear.
Lord, I think Jenny from work is struggling. Help me be someone she can talk to, and help me just listen instead of fixing.
why: ready to listen to a friend

text: There's a new family at church who just arrived from Ukraine. I remember being new and nobody talking to me. I want to invite them for lunch.
A new guy started on our team today and ate alone. Tomorrow I'm going to ask him to join us. Give me courage.
For the first time since the divorce I woke up and wanted to make breakfast. Small, but it felt like light.
why: first hopeful sign after hard season

text: The chemo's done. Long road still, but I can see a little further than before.
Day 3 sober and it's taking everything I have. Please keep me from going to the shop tonight.
I keep losing my temper with the kids no matter how many times I promise myself I won't. Help me change.
why: recurring pattern she wants to break

text: My dad's in the ICU after a stroke. Please be with the doctors and with him.
The flare-up is back and I can barely get out of bed. Lord, I'm so tired of being sick.
Rent is due Monday and we're $400 short. I don't know where it's coming from.
Got laid off today. Twelve years at that company. How do I tell the kids?
The fridge is almost empty and payday is ten days away. Provide, Lord.
My husband and I had another fight about his mother. We went to bed without speaking.
My daughter hasn't spoken to me since Easter. I miss her and I don't know how to fix it.
I found the messages on his phone. Eight years and he's been lying to me the whole time.
My best friend told everyone what I told her in confidence. I feel so stupid for trusting her.
I keep trying and nothing changes. Same job, same debts, same fights. I don't see it ever getting better.
What's even the point of praying anymore. Nothing ever moves.
The scan came back clear! We prayed for months for this. Thank You, Lord.
You did it. The adoption went through.
Sat on the porch with my coffee and watched the rain. Everything felt still. Thank You for this quiet.
For once my mind is quiet. I just feel safe in You tonight.
Hi God. Not sure what to say today.
Mixed day. Some good, some not. Anyway.
My parents are coming for Sunday lunch, I made a roast and we're watching the match after. Just an ordinary day. Amen.
I studied all weekend for the exam and it went fine. Hospitality shift tonight then bed.
I'm not angry with him, just really sad that we're not close anymore.
Oh great, the boiler's broken again. Perfect timing, Lord, really. Love that for me.
Emily's wedding is next week and she's radiant. But Dad won't be there to walk her down the aisle, and I can't stop thinking about the empty chair.
why: joy and grief; grief more pressing

text: My friend Sarah's husband just lost his job and she's terrified about their mortgage. Please look after them.
Lord, You feel so far away tonight. Are You even listening?
Not lonely exactly. I have people. I just miss the version of me that lived in Glasgow.
why: negation of 'lonely'; longing for home place

text: Different day, same struggle. Bought the cigarettes again.
Bit of a rough week. Mum's back in hospital, but she's in good hands. I'm fine. Really.
Got the promotion. Funny how I don't feel anything about it. Everything's just grey lately.
why: good news masking ongoing low mood

text: The film tonight had so much danger and drama, loved it. Thankful for a night out with the girls.
I'm not worried about the money anymore. It's my son I'm worried about. He's stopped answering my calls.
why: negated money; worry about estranged son
